intent: Repair the Sublimation Foundry so provider failures are typed and fail over without false no-op proposals or phantom spend; persist terminal kill state across restarts; represent survivor artifacts as replay-verifiable cumulative lineage; make receipts unique and append-only with legacy migration and integrity diagnostics; require an isolation proof before ring-2 promotion; ship truthful systemd semantics, dependency/status helpers, and a zero-spend five-run hermetic pilot. This packet does not authorize live provider calls, deployment, VPS mutation, pushing, or promotion from local evidence.

honest_blockers: Hermetic tests and the bounded pilot prove control-flow and evidence semantics only; they do not prove live model quality, provider availability, or production throughput.
No deployment or VPS mutation is authorized in this packet; the operator must install the versioned service after review.
Local isolation evidence cannot authorize external confirmation, guardian quorum, merge, or production promotion.
interface_mismatches: Provider exceptions are currently converted to empty content and then mislabeled as no_op_diff, preventing the configured fallback route from running.
Survivors currently retain only the latest delta, while later runs seed from a compounded tree; a fresh checkout cannot replay the claimed artifact from that delta alone.
Receipt filenames can collide and overwrite prior evidence; legacy receipt directories need compatibility reads plus missing/orphan detection.
The daemon exits on a terminal kill metric but Restart=always revives it, and the terminal decision is not persisted independently of the process.
Promotion metadata records degraded isolation but does not make isolation proof a non-coercible prerequisite for ring-2 confirmation.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the scoped commit and reinstall the prior Foundry service unit. Runtime receipts remain append-only evidence and must not be deleted during rollback.
